study_id: Agasthi et al. - 2020 - Machine learning helps predict long-term mortality and graft failure in patients undergoing heart tr

eligibility.Eligibility Rationale: The study analyzes adult heart transplant recipients using a gradient‑boosted machine (non‑linear AI) to predict 5‑year mortality and graft failure, meeting all population, intervention, comparator, outcome, and study design criteria.

identification_methods.Comments: Retrospective analysis using ISHLT registry to develop a gradient‑boosted machine model predicting 5‑year mortality and graft failure after orthotopic heart transplant.
identification_methods.Institution: Department of Cardiovascular Medicine, Mayo Clinic
identification_methods.Address: 5777 E Mayo Blvd, Phoenix, AZ 85054, USA
identification_methods.Dataset Source: International Society of Heart and Lung Transplant (ISHLT) Registry
identification_methods.Identification Notes: Included adults ≥18 years who underwent orthotopic heart transplant between 2005 and 2009 with 5‑year follow‑up; excluded multi‑organ transplants, prior transplants, missing key variables.
identification_methods.Input Variables: 342 variables extracted, reduced to 87 after removing >50% missing and near‑zero variance features.
identification_methods.Missing Data Handling: Variables missing >50% of observations were excluded; near‑zero variance variables removed; categorical blanks recoded as 'No'.
identification_methods.Validation Method: 10‑fold cross‑validation repeated 5 times with an 80/20 training‑validation split.
identification_methods.Methods Notes: Hyperparameters tuned during cross‑validation; model performance assessed by AUC on holdout set; sensitivity, specificity, PPV, NPV also reported.

population.Inclusion criteria: All patients >= 18 years, who underwent orthotopic heart transplant with follow-up data available at 5 years
population.Exclusion criteria: Patients who underwent heart/lung transplant; Patients who underwent heart/kidney transplant; Patients with OHT prior to 2005 and after 2009; Patients with history of prior heart transplant
population.Population Notes: Data split into training cohort (80%) and validation cohort (20%); derived from ISHLT registry 2005-2009

interventions_outcomes.Feature Selection Method: Variables missing >50% of observations removed and near-zero variance variables excluded
interventions_outcomes.Temporal Handling: Static baseline data; time-to-event not modeled
interventions_outcomes.Interventions Notes: Tenfold cross‑validation repeated 5 times for hyperparameter tuning
interventions_outcomes.Outcomes Notes: Binary outcomes assessed at 5 years post‑transplant; time‑to‑event not considered
interventions_outcomes.Result data Notes: AUC reported for mortality (0.717) and graft failure (0.716)
interventions_outcomes.Primary Outcome group: All orthotopic heart transplant patients in validation set
interventions_outcomes.Primary Outcome Metric Definition: AUC on completely held‑out validation cohort
interventions_outcomes.Primary Outcome Notes: Good accuracy to predict long‑term mortality and graft failure
